description: This Java source file defines the NamespaceBlockedException class, which is a custom exception used in the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate that a namespace is temporarily blocked or unavailable.

classes.name: NamespaceBlockedException
classes.description: A final, immutable exception class used to signal that a namespace is blocked due to ongoing operations, providing serialization/deserialization support and builder pattern.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance with a default message indicating the namespace is blocked.
